name: A11y Agent Team MCP Server
description: Accessibility scanning and remediation tools for WCAG 2.2 compliance with experimental WCAG 3.0 support. Provides 40+ tools for checking contrast (WCAG 2.x and APCA), headings, links, forms, document metadata, Office/PDF/EPUB scanning, markdown linting, Playwright-based browser testing, veraPDF SARIF output, color blindness simulation, reading level analysis, caption validation, accessibility statement generation, audit persistence with trend tracking, and scan configuration.

submission.notes: Server is local-only (stdio + loopback HTTP), no authentication. Natural fit for the Anthropic MCPB desktop-extension submission path. Remote submission would require a hosted public HTTPS deployment which is out of scope for the current architecture.

authentication.notes: The server runs locally on the user's machine and does not authenticate against any remote service. No OAuth, API key, or account is required.

testCredentials.notes: No credentials needed. Reviewers can run the MCPB bundle directly in Claude Desktop. Setup steps are in mcp-server/README.md; sample scan targets are in the example/ directory of the repository.

stdio.notes: Primary transport for MCPB and Claude Desktop installs.

http.notes: Streamable HTTP transport bound to loopback for developer testing. Not a public endpoint. Not used for directory submission.
